identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, 'Friends Of The Oakland Public School Libraries', EIN 45-3190035, Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda name and location

Organization's own website (fopsl.org) describes a library revitalization program for Oakland school libraries and discusses Oakland Unified School District libraries, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' MOU with the Academics and Instructional Innovation Department
research.notes: Contact details deliberately omitted: the fopsl.org contact page shows a 555-prefix phone number and a '1234 Webster Street' address that look like placeholders, and the email is obfuscated. ProPublica says the EIN is not in the IRS's most recent exempt-organization list, and Oakland Literacy Coalition says the school library work moved under its School Library Partnerships program as of January 2022, so the entity's current status may have changed.

profile.legalName: Friends Of The Oakland Public School Libraries
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California that works to revitalize school libraries in Oakland's public schools. It runs a Library Revitalization Program, a volunteer network and student literacy projects, aiming to give students access to library services despite budget and staffing limits.
